decision: Accept the CPU encoder/export bridge only if the native RNE law, physical six-tensor ABI, TP4 assembly, and fail-closed loading all pass exact independent checks.
roles: Public deterministic synthetic fixtures only; no model or calibration roles opened.
gates: All 65536 encoder state labels equal the scalar IEEE-half then E2M1 RNE oracle, byte for byte including signed zero.
The six-tensor rank ABI reconstructs all gate, up and down matrices exactly over TP4, with no swaps or uncharged globals.
Deterministic synthetic FC1 and FC2 routed outputs agree with an independently assembled dense CPU reference.
Export, ordinary safetensors reload, strict reload, file hashes and exact integer/rational stored rates agree.
Legacy laws, mixed source identities, invalid positive scales, malformed containers, omitted or duplicate projections, and wrong rank bindings fail closed.
failure_policy: Preserve each failed test log. Amend implementation with a new receipt; do not erase failed attempts.
claim_boundary: No real encoder GPU run, device closure, integrated serving execution, KLD, or speed is established by this stage.
